items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: We had Charlie Shavers, Teddy Wilson, Al Hall, Specs Powell and Trummy Young.

ctx.x: And then the rest was people like Teddy Wilson, Al Hall, Roy Eldridge, Charlie Shavers, Willie Smith, Ben Webster, Trummy Young, Will Bradley, Billy Butterfield for a while.
That was considered an outside show?
